title: Vibrant
text: Vibrant. This hall way rug is a vibrant red carpet. It looks just like the photos. When it arrived, it was folded in half. I've had this in my hallway for over a week now. The middle where it was folded has a line where the fibers of the rug were spread out in the folding. It's slowly fixing itself, but it's still a bit noticeable. The quality of the rug is satisfactory. I am pleased with how it looks in my entry way!

product_metadata.title: Nautica Runner Rug | Indoor Carpet for Entryway & Hallway Rug| Non-Slip and Non-Skid Entry and Kitchen Door Mat| Machine Washable Low Profile Floor Mat | 26" x 60"| Stripe Dark Grey and White
features: 𝗡𝗔𝗨𝗧𝗜𝗖𝗔 𝗧𝗨𝗙𝗧𝗘𝗗 𝗥𝗨𝗡𝗡𝗘𝗥 𝗥𝗨𝗚 𝗖𝗢𝗟𝗟𝗘𝗖𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 – Welcome comfort and style to your home. Nautica’s designer runner rug collection combines elegance and simplicity creating a modern look and design. This multi-purpose runner carpet collection is the perfect combination of beautiful design and functionality with it's classic patterns and colors, easy maintenance, low profile, and non-skid backing. This rug mat runner will effortlessly enhance your entryway, hallway, living room, kitchen, and dining room.

𝗔𝗕𝗦𝗢𝗥𝗕𝗦 𝗠𝗢𝗜𝗦𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘 𝗔𝗡𝗗 𝗗𝗜𝗥𝗧 - Our Nautica rug collection can quickly absorb moisture and dirt to protect your floors, keeping them clean and dry by trapping dirt, food, and liquid. This runner rug carpet is ideal for your kitchen, hallway, bedroom, laundry room, mudroom, bathroom, dining room or other common areas.

𝗡𝗢𝗡 𝗦𝗞𝗜𝗗 𝗕𝗔𝗖𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚 - Non-slip coated latex backing ensures that your rug will firmly stay in place to provide extra safety for you and your family making it great for high traffic areas. The runner mat must be placed on a dry surface during use. A wet surface may result in slippage.

𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗣𝗘𝗥𝗙𝗘𝗖𝗧 𝗙𝗜𝗧 - Our mat features a 0.4 inch slim, low profile design that allows doors to easily open over the rug and prevents tripping making it safe to be place in a doorway or entryway. This collection comes in an array of classic colors, stylish patterns and size options allowing you to find the perfect rug for your entryway, front door, home, office, patio, kitchen, mudroom, and bathroom.

𝗘𝗔𝗦𝗬 𝗖𝗔𝗥𝗘 - Simply vacuum the rug, sweep with a broom or shake off debris. For a deeper clean, this rug collection is machine washable and can be placed in the dryer. We recommend to machine wash cold separately, tumble dry on low and do not iron.

𝗣𝗟𝗘𝗔𝗦𝗘 𝗡𝗢𝗧𝗘 - This rug may have creases when opened due to the way it is packaged for shipping. Open the door rug entirely and place it on an even, flat, dry floor and allow the creases to flatten over a couple of days. The digital images featured on the website are as accurate as possible. Due to differences in computer monitors, some rug colors may vary slightly.
